Problem areas
11. Shared access paths
12. Highway
13. Housing estate
14. Local roads
15. Picnic area

analyses.content: 录音明确提到计划把这些小路变成周围有草地的开阔区域，直接对应选项中的“创造新的草地区域”。
你可能听到录音后面的“native trees”就急着选D，但要注意这里的动词是“remove（移除）”为了避免事故，而不是去种树。

"For the shared access paths, by those I mean the paths shared by both bikes and pedestrians. We plan to turn these into open areas with grass around them. Cyclists and pedestrians need to be able to see each other clearly to avoid any accidents. So we've decided to remove the large native trees from the area for that reason."
录音中说到要在高速公路沿线放一些本地原生的树木来增加阴凉，完美对应“种植本地树木”。
你可能会被后面补充的具体树名“spotted gum（斑点桉）”干扰，只要抓住前半句清晰的“put trees that are native”就能稳稳选对。
"Now, along the highway, we want to put trees that are native to this area to add shade and make it more attractive. We thought possibly the spotted gum, which grows naturally here."
为了解决住宅区的交通噪音问题，录音指出要建一堵墙，建墙挡音也就是选项说的“建隔音障”。
你可能听到后面提到的“adding some artwork”就想去过度发散，但这只是未来可能的设想，当下核心的改变动作是建墙。

"Now, I know those of you who live in the housing estate are disturbed by the sound of traffic nearby. We are aiming to solve this problem by constructing a wall between the estate and the road, and possibly in the future, we might consider adding some artwork to it. We think this will be quite an effective solution."
为了鼓励公交出行并解决交通问题，录音明确表示要在沿途公交路线上增加大量站点，直接对应“提供更多公交站”。
听到“traffic problems”你可能凭主观常识想选安装红绿灯，做听力必须严格基于录音给出的“add stops”客观方案来选。

"Moving on now to the local roads. We want to encourage more public transport use and solve some of our traffic problems, so we're going to add a considerable number of stops to the bus routes that run along those roads."
录音提到要通过增加色彩鲜艳的新玫瑰花床来美化野餐区，玫瑰花直接对应选项中的“开花植物”。
你听到“bus terminal”可能会联想到交通相关的干扰选项，但在这里它仅仅是用来指明野餐区位置的参照物，别被带偏方向。

"Just finally, as a way of thanking the community for their cooperation, we plan to make the picnic area in the park near the bus terminal more attractive. So we're adding some colorful new rosebeds that our gardeners will be putting in at the completion of the project."
录音直接点明停车场的入口在Progress Road和Garden Road的交汇拐角处，看图可以直接锁定唯一的拐角位置A。
如果做地图题没能第一时间抓住“corner”这个决定性的绝对位置词，你很容易在图上的大片空白区域漫无目的地乱看而跟丢。

"To this end, we're building an underground park and ride car park so commuters can drive to the station, park, and then ride to work on the train. That's the entrance to it on the corner of Progress and Garden Road. You can drive into it from Progress Road."
录音给出了极度清晰的绝对方向词“在地图的左上角（top left）”，在这个大方向下的对应位置只有G。
你可能会被后面描述通勤功能的“access to the platform”分散注意力跑去看月台周边，只要死死咬住“左上角”这个初始大方向就不会出错。

"Now, on the Progress Road side of the site, on the top left of your map is where we plan to put the bus interchange. Commuters will have direct access to the platform from the bus interchange via a covered walkway."
录音精确指出了储物柜位于“左下角（bottom left-hand corner）”并且紧挨着自行车道，两者条件结合锁定C。
如果你光听到“next to the bike path”而漏掉了最重要的“左下角”方向前提，很容易顺着车道一直往下找，从而错选成另一头的H。

"Cycling is an important part of our city's transport plan, so cyclists will also be fully catered for with eighty new bicycle lockers. You can see where they are on the plan in the bottom left-hand corner next to the bike path."
录音说明淋浴间被安装在厕所和月台之间，在图上找到这两个明确参照物，夹在中间的正是D。
没有绝对方向词引导时，如果你没能迅速在图上定位到“toilets”和“platform”这两个起终点已知参照物，就无法判断出究竟谁被夹在中间。
"Oh, and I forgot the most important thing. You'll even be able to shower at the station after your bike ride, as we're installing showers between the toilets and the platform."
录音先让你在正中心找到喷泉，接着说明电梯位于喷泉和自动售票机之间，连接图上这两点，中间位置即为F。
因为“喷泉”是图中没有预先标出的新事物，如果你漏听了“喷泉在中心”这个关键的基准点铺垫，听到“在两者之间”时就会因为少了一个端点而迷失方向。

"We'll also install a fountain at the station to make the area more attractive. You can see it in the center of the plan. And between the fountain and the ticket machine, we're putting in a lift for our elderly and disabled passengers. They will be able to buy their ticket, then pass directly to the platform via the lift."
